title: ywec.b: gradient lookup_by_iid provenance audit (prefix+IID vs routable destinations)
description: Child of project-LICHEN-worker6-ywec. lichen-node/src/gradient.rs:174-183 lookup_by_iid matches e.destination[8..] == iid. Gradient destinations are written two ways: announce path builds prefix[0..8]||iid (announce.rs:232) but GradientSource::Rpl entries exist (gradient.rs tests, callers TBD) and may carry routable /128 destinations post-AddrForKey. Enumerate ALL writers of GradientTable entries, pin down each destination form; if RPL-sourced destinations are routable, lookup_by_iid silently mismatches - fix call sites to match by full address for routable forms. Line 318 is a test using lookup_by_iid. Same review as mjm7: link-local/IID-constructed destinations keep IID matching; routable ones must correlate by full address.
